chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Isa who said:

Abu al-Qasim Mukhallad ibn Musa al-Razi wrote to the man (Imam), asking him about the Umrah al-Mabtulah: Is the Tawaf al-Nisa upon its performer? And the Umrah which one performs with Tamattu' to the Hajj? So he wrote: As for the Umrah al-Mabtulah, then upon its performer is the Tawaf al-Nisa; and as for the one which is performed with Tamattu' to the Hajj, then there is not upon its performer the Tawaf al-Nisa.

key_terms.إِلَى الْحَجِّ: To the Hajj (indicating the connection or combination with the Hajj ritual)
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمَبْتُولَةِ: Umrah al-Mabtulah (a standalone Umrah performed independently of Hajj)
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa (the farewell circumambulation performed at the end of Hajj or Umrah)
key_terms.يُتَمَتَّعُ بِهَا: Performs Tamattu' (a type of Hajj where Umrah and Hajj are performed separately with a break in Ihram)

ai.seo_question: Does a pilgrim performing Umrah al-Tamattu' need to perform Tawaf al-Nisa?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the ritual requirement of 'Tawaf al-Nisa' (the farewell circumambulation) for two specific types of Umrah. It distinguishes between the 'Umrah al-Mabtulah' (a standalone Umrah performed independently of Hajj), which requires Tawaf al-Nisa, and the 'Umrah al-Tamattu'' (Umrah performed with the intention of combining it with Hajj), which does not require Tawaf al-Nisa as the pilgrim remains in the state of Ihram for the Hajj rituals. This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the farewell Tawaf is tied to the completion of the specific pilgrimage act, ensuring the pilgrim's exit from the sacred state is properly concluded.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Isa who said,

‘Abu Al-Qasim Mukhallad Bin Musa Al-Razy wrote to the man (Imamasws, asking himasws about the exclusive Umra, ‘Is there the performance of Tawaaf Al-Nisa upon him, and the Umra which he performs Tumatto with to the Hajj?’ So heasws wrote: ‘As for the exclusive Umra, so upon its performer is the Tawaaf Al-Nisa; and as for the performer of the Tumatto to the Hajj, so there is Tawaaf Al-Nisa to be performed by him’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa who has said the following: “

Abu al-al-Qasim Mukhallad ibn Musa al-Raziy wrote to the man, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, asking him (the Imam) about al-‘Umrah al-Mabtulah: if one performing it is required to perform Tawaf al-Nisa’ and in al-‘Umrah for al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous). He (the Imam) wrote for him, ‘In al-‘Umrah al- Mabtulah one is required to perform Tawaf al-Nisa’ but one who performs al-‘Umrah for al-Hajj al- Tamattu‘ (advantageous) is not required to perform Tawaf al-Nisa’.” NOTE: (Fatwa best explains Hadith 1-9 of this and the following Chapter)
